mapper.insert: insert into sys_no_generator (biz_type, supplier_code, gen_date, last_seq) values (#{bizType}, #{supplierCode}, #{genDate}, 1) on duplicate key update last_seq = last_seq + 1
mapper.select: select last_seq from sys_no_generator where biz_type = #{bizType} and supplier_code = #{supplierCode} and gen_date = #{genDate}
